name: Prompt helpers
description: Command palette entries that ask Lily to explain, review, test or comment the selected code.

promptCommands.name: explain
promptCommands.template:
Explain this {language} code from {file} in plain words:

{selection}

promptCommands.name: find-bugs
promptCommands.description: Look for bugs in the selection
promptCommands.template:
Look for bugs in this {language} code from {file}. List each problem and how to fix it:

{selection}

promptCommands.name: write-tests
promptCommands.template:
Write tests for this {language} code from {file}:

{selection}

promptCommands.name: add-comments
promptCommands.template:
Add short comments to this {language} code from {file}, only where the reason is not obvious:

{selection}
